about_the_game:
Aetherial: Blood of the Banner is a gritty, story-driven Viking survival adventure set in a myth-shrouded North—without the magic. After your clan is betrayed and your banner torn down, you are cast into exile with nothing but your wits and a handful of loyal followers.

Now, on the fringes of the known world, you must rebuild. Hunt to survive, scavenge forgotten places, and explore the lands once ruled by your kin. Make uneasy alliances, settle blood feuds, and lead your warband through moral choices that shape your reputation—and your legacy.

There are no gods here. No prophecies. Just you, the cold, and the weight of your decisions.

content_descriptors.notes: There are sword fights which result in death.

short_description: Exiled and disgraced, you lead a forgotten clan through the frozen wilds to reclaim your family’s honor. Build your warband, forge uneasy alliances, and shape your legacy in this grounded Viking survival adventure.
